chunks: Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about two women who killed a man intentionally. He said: “They shall both be killed for him; no one differs concerning it.”

key_terms.بِهِ: for him; in retaliation for him
key_terms.تُقْتَلَانِ: the two of them are to be killed

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if two women intentionally kill one man in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding intentional murder committed jointly by two women against one man. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that both are subject to retaliation, presenting the ruling as one upon which there is no disagreement.
